newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistani stocks dip before weekend.
newsitem.headline: Pakistani stocks dip before weekend.

text.p: Pakistani stocks dipped on Friday with little interest even in speculative stocks before the Saturday-Sunday weekend, dealers said.

Sentiment remained bearish as dealers waited for a news conference which the bourse's president Arif Habib was due to give at 3 p.m. (1000 GMT) on the suspension of two brokers for defaulting on share transactions, one dealer said.
The Karachi 100-index dipped 5.16 points, or 0.33 percent, to 1,574.33 amid 102 losers and 32 gainers at 11.02 a.m. (0602 GMT). -- Ibrahim Khan 9221-5685192
